about: Frames are base64. Desktop-to-phone frames are the desktop encodeMessage output (Node v8.serialize, deflate at 8 KiB, 65470-byte fragments); result_json is what the Rust core reads, as serde_json writes it (so integers and doubles stay apart). Phone-to-desktop frames are what the Rust core writes; the desktop MessageAssembler read each back as the intended value when recorded. Regenerate only on an intended contract change (.playwright/rust-computer-connect/p1/gen-vectors.ts).
